incident_context.label: rodoviaria landmarks with their municipality's flood exposure
incident_context.sql:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT l.osm_type, l.osm_id, l.name AS landmark_name, l.category, l.municipality,
       l.street, l.housenumber, l.lat, l.lon,
       l.`in_water_2024-05-06` AS landmark_in_water_0506,
       l.`in_water_2024-05-08` AS landmark_in_water_0508,
       s.flooded_segments AS municipality_flooded_segments_0506,
       s.total_segments AS municipality_total_segments
FROM OAH_S3.landmarks_v4 l
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT municipality,
         SUM(CAST(segments AS INT)) AS total_segments,
         SUM(CAST(`segments_in_water_2024-05-06` AS INT)) AS flooded_segments
  FROM OAH_S3.streets_flood_v4
  GROUP BY municipality
) s ON l.municipality = s.municipality) v WHERE LOWER(landmark_name) LIKE '%rodoviaria%' OR LOWER(landmark_name) LIKE '%rodoviária%' LIMIT 5
sample: Sede da Polícia Rodoviária Federal no Rio Grande do Sul

SELECT * FROM (SELECT l.osm_type, l.osm_id, l.name AS landmark_name, l.category, l.municipality,

FROM OAH_S3.landmarks_v4 l
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT municipality,

incident_context.label: landmark count and flooded-segment total per municipality
incident_context.sql:
SELECT municipality, COUNT(*) AS landmarks, MAX(municipality_flooded_segments_0506) AS flooded_segments FROM (SELECT l.osm_type, l.osm_id, l.name AS landmark_name, l.category, l.municipality,
       l.street, l.housenumber, l.lat, l.lon,
       l.`in_water_2024-05-06` AS landmark_in_water_0506,
       l.`in_water_2024-05-08` AS landmark_in_water_0508,
       s.flooded_segments AS municipality_flooded_segments_0506,
       s.total_segments AS municipality_total_segments
FROM OAH_S3.landmarks_v4 l
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT municipality,
         SUM(CAST(segments AS INT)) AS total_segments,
         SUM(CAST(`segments_in_water_2024-05-06` AS INT)) AS flooded_segments
  FROM OAH_S3.streets_flood_v4
  GROUP BY municipality
) s ON l.municipality = s.municipality) v GROUP BY municipality ORDER BY flooded_segments DESC LIMIT 6

asset_availability.label: pumps down on 2024-05-06
asset_availability.sql:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT p.source_fid, p.name AS asset_name, p.municipality, p.lat, p.lon,
       d.date AS status_date, d.status,
       CASE WHEN d.status = 'Inoperante' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_down
FROM OAH_S3.pumps_v4 p
JOIN OAH_S3.pump_status_daily_v4 d ON p.source_fid = d.source_fid) v WHERE status_date='2024-05-06' AND is_down=1 LIMIT 8

asset_availability.label: down-days per municipality
asset_availability.sql:
SELECT municipality, SUM(is_down) AS down_days, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM (SELECT p.source_fid, p.name AS asset_name, p.municipality, p.lat, p.lon,
       d.date AS status_date, d.status,
       CASE WHEN d.status = 'Inoperante' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_down
FROM OAH_S3.pumps_v4 p
JOIN OAH_S3.pump_status_daily_v4 d ON p.source_fid = d.source_fid) v GROUP BY municipality ORDER BY down_days DESC

shelter_capacity.label: shelters currently over capacity, worst first
shelter_capacity.sql:
SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, municipality, facility_type, lat, lon, capacity, sheltered_people, vacancies, snapshot_local,
       CASE WHEN capacity IS NOT NULL AND capacity <> '' AND sheltered_people IS NOT NULL AND sheltered_people <> ''
            THEN CAST(sheltered_people AS DOUBLE) / CAST(capacity AS DOUBLE) END AS occupancy_rate,
       CASE WHEN capacity IS NOT NULL AND capacity <> '' AND sheltered_people IS NOT NULL AND sheltered_people <> ''
                 AND CAST(sheltered_people AS DOUBLE) > CAST(capacity AS DOUBLE)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS over_capacity_flag
FROM OAH_S3.shelters_v4) v WHERE over_capacity_flag=1 ORDER BY occupancy_rate DESC LIMIT 8

data_quality.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS checked,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE over_capacity_flag = 1) AS violations
FROM (SELECT * FROM shelter_capacity) v
WHERE capacity IS NOT NULL AND capacity <> ''

SELECT COUNT(*) AS checked,
       COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE CAST(lat AS DOUBLE) NOT BETWEEN -34 AND -27
                           OR CAST(lon AS DOUBLE) NOT BETWEEN -58 AND -49) AS violations
FROM OAH_S3.landmarks_v4
